stem: What is the solution to the equation \(\frac{x}{x - 3} + \frac{2}{x + 3} = \frac{18}{x^{2} - 9}\)?
solution: Factor the right-hand denominator: \(x^{2} - 9 = (x - 3)(x + 3)\). Note that \(x \neq 3\) and \(x \neq -3\).
\(x = 3\) makes a denominator zero, so it is extraneous. The only solution is \(-8\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
cands = solve(Eq(x*(x + 3) + 2*(x - 3), 18), x)
assert sorted(cands) == [-8, 3]
sols = solve(Eq(x/(x - 3) + 2/(x + 3), 18/(x**2 - 9)), x)
assert sols == [-8]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == sols
